title: Generative multi-domain transfer learning for fault detection in data-scarce wind turbines
abstract: arXiv:2608.30323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Normal behavior models have shown promise for reliable fault detection in wind turbines. However, these unsupervised anomaly detection models require sufficient fault-free training data to learn the normal operation behavior of turbines. Under data scarcity, for example in newly deployed wind turbines, these models may result in poor fault detection performance. In this work, we propose a multi-domain generative domain mapping approach based on Star Generative Adversarial Networks (StarGAN) to improve fault detection on data-scarce wind turbines. Our model maps SCADA measurements from a data-scarce turbine to resemble those of several data-rich turbines. By preserving the operational state during translation, faults occurring in a data-scarce domain can be mapped and detected by reliable pre-trained normal behavior models of data-rich domains. translated_title: 面向数据稀缺风电机组故障检测的生成式多域迁移学习方法
translated_abstract: 正常行为模型在风电机组的可靠故障检测中已展现出良好的前景。然而，这些无监督异常检测模型需要充足的无故障训练数据来学习风电机组的正常运行行为。在数据稀缺的情况下，例如新部署的风电机组，这些模型的故障检测性能可能较差。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于星型生成对抗网络的多域生成式域映射方法，以提升数据稀缺风电机组的故障检测能力。我们的模型将来自数据稀缺风机的SCADA测量数据映射为类似多个数据丰富风机的数据。通过在转换过程中保持运行状态不变，发生在数据稀缺域中的故障可以被映射，并由数据丰富域中可靠的预训练正常行为模型进行检测。通过突出集成融合策略的优势，我们证明了在严重数据稀缺的情况下……
tldr: 提出基于StarGAN的多域生成式域映射方法，将数据稀缺风机的SCADA数据转换到数据丰富风机的域中，借助预训练的正常行为模型和集成融合策略，显著提升数据稀缺风电机组的故障检测性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes a StarGAN-based multi-domain generative domain mapping approach that translates SCADA data from data-scarce wind turbines to data-rich domains, enabling reliable fault detection through pre-trained normal behavior models combined with an ensemble fusion strategy.
